0.original: Zero wishes to know your next destination.

24.original: Wait at the designated location outside Meghaduta.

25.original: Speak with Zero at Saltwind's Welcome.

26.original: Gather information near the Hamsa Hatchery.

48.original: Vrtra has quelled the tempest within his heart. He should be fine.

49.original: That Azdaja's eye hasn't succumbed to Darkness bespeaks her incredible resilience.

50.original: So let us trust in this sign that she yet lives, and be not deterred in our efforts.

51.original: I must apologize for my bout of melancholy. To be so easily shaken ill becomes a great wyrm.

52.original: You have remained at my side and ever offered me support and encouragement. I haven't the words to thank you.

53.original: Am I right in assuming that we are to return to the void?

55.original: Now that matters here have been settled, yes. But first, we should return to Radz-at-Han to prepare. When everyone is ready, let us convene at Meghaduta.

56.original: We know the fiend was headed north...

57.original: But that still leaves a lot of ground for us few to cover.

58.original: We need a way to conduct our search more efficiently. Do you have any ideas?

60.original: I know people who may have seen something.

61.original: We split up and make inquiries.

62.original: In other words, we seek help from the locals? If you think it best, then very well.

64.original: In other words, we seek help from the locals? If you think it best, then very well.

66.original: The Great Work and the encampment at the Hamsa Hatchery? If both places are to the north, then the people there may indeed have seen something.

67.original: Very well, I will head to the Great Work, and leave the encampment to you.

68.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Is this about the happenings at the Bhaflau remnants?

69.original: Saw the light over at the Bhaflau remnants too, did you? We've sent scouts to investigate, but they've yet to report back.

70.original: We will continue to keep watch here, but if you learn anything, be sure to let us know.

71.original: These fishermen saw a fiend emerge from the Bhaflau remnants before heading north, you say?

72.original: I saw what I thought was a ball of flame flung from the explosion, but now I wonder...

73.original: It flew north, in the direction of Khadga. If it is in fact a fiend, then we have trouble on our hands. We must remain vigilant.

74.original: Ever since that explosion, we've seen nothing else unusual come from the waters, but there's no telling what our scouts may report.

75.original: In case you're unfamiliar, Khadga is the massive rock formation that juts out over the water. That's where the ball of flame flew.

76.original: I presume you've come to investigate the explosion at the Bhaflau remnants as well.

77.original: We've yet to ascertain precisely what happened. Is there any information you can share with us?

78.original: A fiend emerged from the explosion and flew towards Khadga!? By the Sisters! Had I learned of this sooner─never mind. There is no time to waste!
